text:
noah_releng: heads up — deploybot reports worker OOMs popping up in canary for /summarize. Autorevert is queued. Do we want a manual intervention instead of letting it flip?

deploybot: ALERT: Canary OOMs detected on model-worker pods (count 12). Error-rate rising. Autorevert in 90s unless overridden. details: https://telemetry/reports/1747777

alisha_oncall: oncall here. Are these true OOMs or evictions from node pressure?

dmitri_eng: it's genuine process OOMs after the new memory allocator tweak (PR 637). Sequence lengths > 8k trigger ballooning in worst-case. No HTTP 5xx yet but pods dying and restarting.

norah_releng: (typo) meant to say @noah_releng. Proposal: apply a short manual hold so we can pin the prod route to redwood-gen-v3-stable and revert the allocator tweak on canary. Pin avoids touching customer traffic during investigation.

mica_pm: product note — customers using long-sequence summarization (enterprise) may be affected if we hit prod. If we pin, please include a one-line CSM blurb.

alisha_oncall: applying hold now. `deploybot override --thread 1747777000 --hold 600 --reason "investigate OOMs on allocator tweak"`

deploybot: ACTION: Autorevert HOLD applied by alisha_oncall for 600s. Manual rollback still allowed.

dmitri_eng: initiating plan: 1) pin prod route to stable model to prevent rollout spillover 2) revert PR 637 on canary 3) redeploy canary and run smoke 4) unpin if safe. Pin command ready: `rctrl pin-route --route /summarize --model redwood-gen-v3-stable --comment "protect prod during OOM investigation"`

noah_releng: go ahead with pin, post CSM blurb after pin is applied.

dmitri_eng: pin applied at 1747777032. logs: `rctrl: route /summarize pinned to redwood-gen-v3-stable by dmitri_eng`

mica_pm: CSM blurb draft: "We've detected elevated worker memory exits in canary tied to a recent allocator change. We've pinned production route to the stable model while we investigate; no customer-facing degradation expected. Will update when fixed."

alisha_oncall: copy that.

dmitri_eng: reverting PR 637 now: `git revert --no-edit 637 && infra/deploy --env canary --tag v3.7.0-revert-alloc`

deploybot: ACTION: deployment started for v3.7.0-revert-alloc (canary).

dmitri_eng: revert finished 1747777090. smoke: `smoke: no OOMs; pod restarts 0; p95 unchanged`

noah_releng: great. Recommend 10m monitoring then unpin and cancel hold. Anyone object?

mica_pm: no objections. I'll notify CSMs with the blurb and ETA for unpin.

alisha_oncall: canceling hold in 10m if stable. For now keep pin for containment.

dmitri_eng: creating follow-up ticket to add a safety-gate for allocator changes, and add a long-sequence load test into preflight CI (ENG-ops-412).

noah_releng: after 10m of clean metrics, we'll unpin. Marking thread as resolved pending monitoring. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
